description: This Java class ArtifactInfoContext manages collections of entity names, service names, and simple methods within the context of artifact processing in the OFBiz minilang framework. It provides methods to add and retrieve entity and service names, track visited simple methods, and check if a method has been visited.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoContext
classes.description: A utility class for collecting and checking artifact-related information such as entity names, service names, and visited simple methods during processing.

methods.name: addEntityName
methods.description: Adds a non-null entity name to the entityNameSet within the context.

methods.name: addServiceName
methods.description: Adds a non-null service name to the serviceNameSet within the context.

methods.name: addSimpleMethod
methods.description: Records a visited SimpleMethod by adding its location and name to the simpleMethodNameSet.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns the set of entity names stored in the context.

methods.name: getServiceNames
methods.description: Returns the set of service names stored in the context.

methods.name: hasVisited
methods.description: Checks whether a given SimpleMethod has already been visited in this context.
